mechanism_narrative: A rising GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE above 5.5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 5.5% but S&P 500 returns remain positive more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: If CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% monthly while FEDFUNDS does not adjust, it may signal inflation pressures without corresponding monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS remains unchanged
failure_condition: If the described condition occurs but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST indicates stronger housing demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by 5% but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: If PAYEMS increases by more than 150,000, it signals strong labor market growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 25% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rising INDPRO indicates increased industrial production, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth exceeds 3% but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: If GDPC1 growth slows while UNRATE rises, it indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 2% and UNRATE increases by 0.2%
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in RSAFS indicates strong consumer demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases by 5% but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.
